subtree_size(prefix):   (how many numbers in 1..n start with prefix)
    low = prefix, high = prefix + 1, total = 0
    while low <= n:

erect_the_fence.optimal:
cross(o, a, b) = (a.x - o.x) * (b.y - o.y) - (a.y - o.y) * (b.x - o.x)
half_hull(points):
    chain = empty stack
    for each p in points:
        while chain has >= 2 points and cross(second from top, top, p) < 0:
            pop the top   (clockwise turn: the middle tree is inside; collinear trees stay)
        push p
    return chain

spread_evenly(line):
    gaps = size of line - 1, spaces = max_width - total letters in line
    each = spaces / gaps, extra = spaces mod gaps   (the leftmost extra gaps get one more)
    return each word but the last followed by its spaces, then the last word

shortest_palindrome.optimal:
text = s + "#" + reverse of s   ("#" stops a border from crossing the middle)
fail = zeros, one per character of text   (fail[i] = longest proper border of text[0..i])
for i from 1 to the end of text:
    k = fail[i - 1]
    while k > 0 and text[i] != text[k]:
        k = fail[k - 1]   (fall back to a shorter border)
    if text[i] == text[k]: k += 1
    fail[i] = k
keep = last entry of fail   (longest palindromic prefix of s)
return reverse of s[keep..] + s

longest_duplicate_substring.optimal:
codes = each letter of s as a number 1..26
find_repeat(length):   (start of some window of this length seen earlier, or -1)
    h = hash of codes[0..length) as a base-BASE number mod MOD
    seen = dict hash -> list of starts, starting as {h: [0]}
    power = BASE ^ length mod MOD   (weight of the character leaving the window)
    for each start i from 1 to n - length:
        h = (h * BASE - codes[i - 1] * power + codes[i + length - 1]) mod MOD   (slide by one)
        if h in seen:
            if s[j..j + length) == s[i..i + length) for some j in seen[h]: return i   (a real repeat)
            append i to seen[h]
        else: seen[h] = [i]
    return -1
lo = 1, hi = n - 1, start = -1, best = 0
while lo <= hi:   (a repeat of length L implies one of every shorter length: binary search on L)
    mid = (lo + hi) / 2, i = find_repeat(mid)
    if i >= 0: start = i, best = mid, lo = mid + 1
    else: hi = mid - 1
return s[start..start + best) if start >= 0 else ""
